# LLM Configuration File for Eric Cao's Personal Website

This file provides metadata about the structure and content of this website to help large language models (LLMs) understand and navigate it effectively.

- **Purpose**: Personal portfolio and technical blog

- **Languages**: Simplified Chinese (primary), English (auto-translated via Lingo.dev)
- **Category**: Personal Portfolio / Technology Blog

## Featured Projects

1. **airflow-extended-api-plugin** (77 stars)
   - Airflow plugin wrapping RESTful APIs via CLI commands, supports Airflow v2.X
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou/airflow-extended-api-plugin

2. **cnpip** (61 stars)
   - One-click speed test and switch for pip & uv mirrors
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou/cnpip

3. **MermZen** (13 stars)
   - Minimalist Mermaid diagram editor, no login required, real-time preview, PNG/SVG export
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou/MermZen
   - Demo: https://eric.run.place/MermZen/

## Site Structure

```
/                    # Home — hero, projects, topic cards
/blog                # Blog post list
/blog/[slug]         # Individual blog post (Chinese)
/llms.txt            # This file
```

## Content Collections

- **profile**: Personal info, social links
- **projects**: Showcase projects with descriptions and star counts
- **thoughts**: Homepage topic cards (bilingual: zh + en)
- **posts/zh**: Blog articles (Chinese source, written by author)
- **posts/en**: Blog articles (English, auto-generated by Lingo.dev)

## Technology Stack

- **Static Site Generator**: Astro 5.x
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript
- **3D Background**: Three.js (animated particles and geometric shapes)
- **i18n**: Lingo.dev — Chinese source files auto-translated to English on push
- **Deployment**: GitHub Actions → GitHub Pages

- **Background**: #080c14

- **Text Primary**: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92)
